species: Giraffe (Giraffa camelopardalis) snort, a burst of air through the nostrils; giraffes are nearly silent and the snort is the sound people hear from them most often
note: The high-pass is set to 80 Hz because the original has strong rumble below 80 Hz that is just as loud before and after the snort; the snort itself is above 100 Hz.
